description: This is a TypeScript test file for the ACP policy module, containing unit tests for policy evaluation functions such as enabling/disabling ACP and dispatch, and allowed agents filtering.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for ACP policy behavior.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertion function to verify test expectations.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases within the test suite.

methods.name: isAcpAgentAllowedByPolicy
methods.description: Checks if a given agent is allowed based on the policy.

methods.name: isAcpDispatchEnabledByPolicy
methods.description: Checks if ACP dispatch is enabled based on the policy.

methods.name: isAcpEnabledByPolicy
methods.description: Checks if ACP overall is enabled based on the policy.

methods.name: resolveAcpAgentPolicyError
methods.description: Resolves any policy error related to an agent.

methods.name: resolveAcpDispatchPolicyError
methods.description: Resolves any policy error related to dispatch.

methods.name: resolveAcpDispatchPolicyMessage
methods.description: Provides message details about the dispatch policy state.

methods.name: resolveAcpDispatchPolicyState
methods.description: Determines the current state of the dispatch policy.
